hints.title: Non-Overlapping Segments
hints.text: Two intervals of length k can be placed disjointly or adjacently to collect prizes without penalty.

hints.title: Sliding Window per Segment
hints.text: For each right endpoint r, find the leftmost index l such that prizePositions[r] - prizePositions[l] <= k.

hints.title: Prefix Maximum Combination
hints.text: Maintain pre[l], the maximum prizes collectable by one segment ending on or before index l - 1, and combine with the current segment.

hints.title: Sliding Window Prefix DP Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maximizeWin(self, prizePositions: list[int], k: int) -> int:
        n = len(prizePositions)
        pre = [0] * (n + 1)
        l = 0
        ans = 0
        for r in range(n):
            while prizePositions[r] - prizePositions[l] > k:
                l += 1
            cnt = r - l + 1
            ans = max(ans, cnt + pre[l])
            pre[r + 1] = max(pre[r], cnt)
        return ans
```
